description: This file defines the BlobReporter class, a test report generator that creates ZIP reports with metadata and attachments for Playwright tests.

classes.name: BlobReporter
classes.description: A class that generates ZIP reports for Playwright tests, including metadata, attachments, and test results.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the BlobReporter with options, sets up message handling, and validates the filename.

methods.name: onConfigure
methods.description: Sets up report metadata and stores the test configuration.

methods.name: onTestPaused
methods.description: No-op method for handling test pause events, relevant only for interactive use.

methods.name: onEnd
methods.description: Finalizes the report by creating a ZIP file with metadata and attachments.

methods.name: _prepareOutputFile
methods.description: Prepares the output file path, removing old reports if necessary, and creates directories.

methods.name: _defaultReportName
methods.description: Generates a default report filename based on configuration and options.

methods.name: _serializeAttachments
methods.description: Serializes test attachments, adding a hash-based filename to avoid clashes.
